result.summary: Vortex business initiative submitted by Dirk Haas and Karl Fischer: tenant registration must complete as one reliable onboarding flow from data capture to operational readiness. When our team creates a new tenant, the tenant record must become visible in the administration view without delay, the identity authority must be ready for immediate role-based access, and all tenant schema tables required for production and quality workflows must be fully materialized before onboarding is marked complete. This is required so production orders, supplier deviation handling, quarantine controls, and escalation paths can start without manual correction or compliance risk.
